# vengtoo_subject (Data Source)

Look up an existing Vengtoo subject by ID — e.g. to attach a static policy to a subject your application created.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Subject ID.

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) Customer-supplied external ID, if any.
- `name` (String) Subject name.
- `type` (String) Subject type.
